link_fix.original_failure: ProductS5EspHomeMqttBus vtable unresolved at ESP32-C6 final link
link_fix.root_cause: USE_MQTT feature define was visible in the component translation unit before the transport header but not in the transport translation unit, so MQTT bus method definitions were preprocessed out
link_fix.intermediate_failure: unconditional esphome/core/defines.h include broke the standalone host compile include tree
link_fix.final_fix: conditionally include esphome/core/defines.h when available before evaluating USE_MQTT

structural_findings.finding: The public private-package generator was pinned to the pre-transport S5-D implementation head 660acf72b701d9ff8e3a881e97e5d15357286786 and rejected the current transport implementation head.
structural_findings.required_repair: Rebind the private-package materializer to the current reviewed S5 transport/runtime implementation lineage without rewriting the historical preparation record.
structural_findings.resolution: The generator and its host contract are rebound to reviewed private-runtime checkpoint e06c8bc90b08987a17783a1a113ea1aaa81b81c0; no real package was materialized.

structural_findings.finding: No concrete private ProductS5SelfCredentialProvider composition existed for Child or Relay, and no concrete private ProductS5RelayHealthProvider was bound for Relay. Public and compile-only YAML profiles remained intentionally inert and did not invoke configure_s5_isolated/configure_private.
structural_findings.required_repair: Add a generic secret-free host/compile-reviewed private composition path that can consume only each endpoint's own post-registration material at package build time; it must not add factory peer identity or pair LMK.
structural_findings.resolution: greenhouse_n3w_s5_private_runtime now provides own-node-only credential and Relay-health composition, and synthetic ESP32-C6 Child and Relay host/compile targets passed while public/factory profiles remain inert.

structural_findings.finding: N3wProductIsolatedMqttService existed as an explicit opt-in live-capable service, but the private package had no bound isolated Manager launcher/assembly that instantiated it with the existing S4 PeerAuthorizationMqttAdapter and N3-W runtime state. Normal production app.py intentionally did not select it.
structural_findings.required_repair: Provide a host/compile-reviewed isolated-lab-only Manager launcher/assembly while leaving normal production Manager startup unchanged.
structural_findings.resolution: The explicit n3w_product_isolated_app/n3w_product_isolated_launcher composition reuses the existing S4 authority and N3-W runtime; normal production app.py remains unchanged and does not select the isolated launcher.

structural_findings.finding: The historical private package input contract did not bind the isolated Relay Wi-Fi configuration, MQTT broker/client configuration, or the ESP-NOW/AP channel compatibility required by the real Relay-to-Manager path.
structural_findings.required_repair: Extend only the private one-shot package contract to bind isolated-lab network/broker/channel inputs; these values must never enter public/factory profiles or public evidence.
structural_findings.resolution: The private one-shot package contract now validates isolated Wi-Fi/MQTT fields and requires the bound Wi-Fi channel to equal the ESP-NOW channel; only synthetic compile fixtures are public.
